mapper.sql: DATA_SRC_ID, DATA_SRC_NM, DB_TYPE_DVCD, JDBC_URL, DB_USER_ID, MINI_POOL_CNT, MAX_POOL_CNT, QUERY_TIMEOUT_SEC, USE_YN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM DXAPI_DATASOURCE_M ORDER BY DATA_SRC_ID
SELECT MAX(DATA_SRC_ID) FROM DXAPI_DATASOURCE_M WHERE DATA_SRC_ID LIKE #{like}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M WHERE DATA_SRC_ID = #{id}
SELECT API_NO AS no, API_NM AS name, REQ_PATH AS path, STTUS_DVCD AS status FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M WHERE DATA_SRC_ID = #{id} ORDER BY API_NO

SELECT DISTINCT s.CONTCT_SYST_ID AS id, s.CONTCT_SYST_NM AS name FROM DXAPI_EXT_SYS_API_MAP_M m JOIN DXAPI_USR_EXT_SYS_M s ON m.CONTCT_SYST_ID = s.CONTCT_SYST_ID WHERE m.API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM DXAPI_API_DEF_M WHERE DATA_SRC_ID = #{id}) ORDER BY s.CONTCT_SYST_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DXAPI_DATASOURCE_M (DATA_SRC_ID, DATA_SRC_NM, DB_TYPE_DVCD, JDBC_URL, DB_USER_ID, DB_ENC_PW, MINI_POOL_CNT, MAX_POOL_CNT, QUERY_TIMEOUT_SEC, USE_YN, REGID) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{dbType}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{dbUser}, #{encPw}, #{poolMin}, #{poolMax}, #{queryTimeoutSec}, #{useYn}, #{regid})
